speaker: A
name: Alex
text: That's the reason so many people love listening to music — it makes them feel better.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Singing is, at its core, about expressing feelings, and when you sing, other people can feel what you feel — it's like a strengthened way of sharing emotions.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: And maybe some songs match exactly what you're going through.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Then you realize that somewhere out there, someone has felt the same way as you — and you feel you're not alone.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: That's how singing brings people happiness.
